geometryRule: No structure may be promoted to verified/shipped geometry without exact source identity, immutable revision, license/attribution, transformation history, and qualified anatomical review.

boundaries: Evidence anchors validate terminology and relationships; they do not license copying figures, images, or meshes.
Reference-only structures are metadata/education targets, not claims of available 3D source geometry.
Pupil and visual axis are conceptual/aperture entities and must never be fabricated as tissue meshes.
No patient-specific geometry, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, surgical coordinate, or procedural guidance is produced by this dataset.
Histology, cell biology, organelles, pathways, proteins, genes and DNA are deliberately deferred until gross-visible Wave 1 passes acceptance.
